title: Universal Engineering Asset Registry
purpose: Provide the canonical persistent identity, lifecycle and evidence registry for every AIAS engineering asset.
scope: Stable IDs, semantic versions, lifecycle transitions, dependencies, requirements, evidence, legal status, atomic persistence, audit events and queries.

requirements.title: Universal asset contract
requirements.statement: Every asset shall expose canonical identity, ownership, purpose, scope, source, requirements, evidence, dependencies and legal status.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Persistent registry
requirements.statement: The registry shall persist assets atomically and reject duplicate identities.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Dependency integrity
requirements.statement: The registry shall reject references to unknown dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Controlled lifecycle
requirements.statement: Lifecycle transitions shall be sequential and auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Evidence queries
requirements.statement: Consumers shall query assets by type and lifecycle state.
requirements.rationale: Enable ACE, Dashboard and PMO consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The capability shall include tests, documentation, installer and checksum release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
